propositions: Routine port-exhausted and retire-cap backoffs were incorrectly emitting AUTODEPLOY_ERROR with reason deploy_failed, inflating the general deploy-errors alarm
Routine low-memory aborts were incorrectly recorded through record_mcp_backoff_failure instead of being treated as non-error deferrals
The defect origin shipped both the documented observability contract (keeping these backoffs out of AUTODEPLOY_ERROR) and violating code that emitted deploy_failed for routine backoffs

The fix separates routine backoff handling via record_mcp_routine_backoff (emits AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP or AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT, writes backoff file, no AUTODEPLOY_ERROR) from genuine deploy failures (still emit AUTODEPLOY_ERROR)
Landed implementation at commit c63d3d9dd passes focused regression tests and lint, with defect-seeded mutation (revert to record_mcp_backoff_failure) correctly killed by routine test cases
